title: GdprLawfulBasis
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — lawful basis for processing personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 6 defines six mutually exclusive lawful bases. At least one must apply to every processing operation. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 6(1)(a)-(f).

lawfulBasis.description: The lawful basis for processing. CONSENT: data subject has given consent for one or more specific purposes (Art 6(1)(a)). CONTRACT: processing necessary for performance of a contract with the data subject (Art 6(1)(b)). LEGAL_OBLIGATION: processing necessary for compliance with a legal obligation (Art 6(1)(c)). VITAL_INTERESTS: processing necessary to protect vital interests of the data subject or another person (Art 6(1)(d)). PUBLIC_TASK: processing necessary for performance of a task in the public interest or official authority (Art 6(1)(e)). LEGITIMATE_INTERESTS: processing necessary for legitimate interests of the controller or third party, except where overridden by data subject rights (Art 6(1)(f)).

lawfulBasisDocumented.description: Whether the lawful basis has been formally documented and communicated to data subjects. Source: GDPR Art 5(2) accountability, Art 13(1)(c), Art 14(1)(c).

legitimateInterestAssessment.description: Whether a legitimate interest assessment (balancing test) has been performed. Required when lawfulBasis is LEGITIMATE_INTERESTS. Source: GDPR Art 6(1)(f).

balancingTestResult.description: Result of the balancing test between controller/third-party legitimate interests and data subject fundamental rights and freedoms. INTERESTS_PREVAIL: processing justified. RIGHTS_PREVAIL: processing not justified. INCONCLUSIVE: further assessment needed. Source: GDPR Art 6(1)(f).
